purpose: qualify an external reference for the Phase-2A assumption-conditioned E_KLF12_HIGH scenarios only; this is not donor personalization

value_blindness.statement: written and committed before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference was read, computed or seen
known_at_writing: candidate metadata only: titles, methods, accession pages, SDRF/IDF, ENA run reports, file listings
the depositor per-cell metadata columns of E-MTAB-10283 WSSS_END9397531/35_cells.tsv (demultiplexed donor label and author Celltype; no gene value)
the ADOC pipeline code (github.com/FCS-BioIT/single-cell-ADOC at 1f15801ae1820cb2fcec7634a8f522fc1da54e79) and the ADOC deposit's SDRF/IDF and matrix headers
the already-committed Phase-1B KLF12 findings for the ADOC cells, which contribute nothing to any rule below except the precedent that a stateless null must be tested

condition_matching.cnt: unresolved (Phase-2A Q4); no CNT unit is matched to any reference and none is mapped
condition_matching.reference_condition_class: hormone_treated, by owner D1 tier T1 or T2 only; T3 and tissue never qualify
recorded_deviations_of_selected_arm_from: R-spondin-1 withdrawn in the WNT-inhibitor arm
organoid culture, not the dual-channel chip

sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (FASTQ read headers; ENA records HiSeq 4000), not NovaSeq X; read 1 is 28 and read 2 is 91 bases in both libraries, checked on the first FASTQ records, as in ADOC

candidate_selection.rule: qualification.select(inventory, min_reference_donors=3): metadata-only D1/D2/D5/D8 qualification, then the D7 order
candidate_selection.fallthrough: a VALUE-BLIND failure of the selected candidate (retrieval checksum, pipeline reproduction, reprocessing, donor-label join, fewer than min_reference_donors donors with cells) passes to the next candidate in the frozen order; a VALUE-AWARE failure (derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION) never does, because trying candidates until one separates would select a reference by its KLF12 distribution
candidate_selection.next_candidates: none: C03 is the only metadata-qualified candidate

donors.source: the depositor's genotype demultiplexing: column 'demultiplexed' of WSSS_END9397531_cells.tsv and WSSS_END9397535_cells.tsv
donors.independence: three genotypes demultiplexed by the depositors (paper: donors E001, B044, B080); the U1/U2 to E001/B080 mapping is unstated and not needed
donors.replicate_libraries: the two libraries are technical replicates of one three-donor pool; cells of both are pooled per donor, and the per-library result is reported as a diagnostic only
donors.no_own_demultiplexing: no genotype inference is run by us; a cell without a depositor donor label is dropped

population.rule: owner D6: the union of the authors' epithelial annotations, by metadata only
population.epithelial_labels: every author Celltype value in the selected libraries except 'Low QC' (an author quality flag, not a lineage): Ciliated, Estrogen_induced_PGR+, Inflamatory, NH_d2_WNTi, NH_d2_d6, NH_d6, NH_d6_WNTi, Pre-ciliated, Secretory_Ctrl, Secretory_NOTCHi, Secretory_WNTi; any other label found at join time is a deviation and is excluded
population.join: our barcode without its '-1' suffix equals the depositor cell name without its 'WSSS_END<library>_' prefix, within the same library
population.forbidden: any expression-based filter (EPCAM or otherwise), re-clustering, or re-annotation

pinned_stack.reference_genome: GRCh38 with GENCODE v47 annotation, as the ADOC IDF states; the built feature table must equal E-MTAB-15842 all_feature_bc_matrix_features.tsv exactly (feature id, name, type, order)
pinned_stack.counting: Cell Ranger count; the version is unrecorded in the ADOC deposit and is identified by the reproduction test below
pinned_stack.ambient_correction: src/upstream/decontx_remove_background.R of FCS-BioIT/single-cell-ADOC at 1f15801ae1820cb2fcec7634a8f522fc1da54e79, per library, raw droplets as background, in the envs/decontx.yaml environment (R 4.4.3, celda 1.22.0)
pinned_stack.qc: the ADOC thresholds of src/scrnaseq-preprocess/qc.R on the decontX counts: nFeature_RNA >= 500, mitoRatio (^MT-, percent) < 15, nCount_RNA >= 1000, then scDblFinder (envs/qc.yaml, scDblFinder 1.20.2, set.seed(47)) doublets removed

stack_identification.test: reprocess the ADOC library SZ09TE_CNT (ENA ERR15772621) from its FASTQ; a candidate stack is accepted only if (a) its raw and filtered feature-barcode matrices are identical to the deposited SZ09TE_CNT_raw_feature_bc_matrix and SZ09TE_CNT_filtered_feature_bc_matrix (same barcodes, same non-zero feature-barcode-count triples) and (b) the pinned decontX step on them reproduces the deposited SZ09TE_CNT decontX matrix with identical barcodes and a maximum absolute entrywise difference <= 1e-6
stack_identification.search_order: a Cell Ranger version documented by the depositors if the owner supplies one before the test runs; otherwise official Cell Ranger releases in descending order starting at 9.0.1; the first release passing (a) and (b) is the pinned stack
stack_identification.value_blindness: the test compares whole matrices for equality; no ADOC or candidate KLF12 value is extracted or summarised
stack_identification.failure: no stack passes -> BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY; a candidate the pinned stack cannot process -> BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY for that candidate

measurement.feature: KLF12 (HGNC symbol), the node's own feature
measurement.layer: decontX-corrected counts produced by the pinned stack
measurement.primary_quantity: count_per_10k = KLF12 decontX count / the cell's decontX column sum x 1e4, exactly as phase2a_contract.per_cell_quantity
measurement.diagnostic_quantity: count, reported only, never a threshold or variant
measurement.per_cell_table: columns donor_id, klf12_count, depth only (no barcode), with a provenance sidecar binding it to the input FASTQ md5s (values.PROVENANCE_COLUMNS)

per_donor_criteria.S1: exactly one posterior-0.5 crossing inside the detected support, between the component means
per_donor_criteria.S2: the fitted two-component density is bimodal
per_donor_criteria.S3: the boundary is at least one molecule at the donor's median detected depth (1e4 / median depth)
per_donor_criteria.posterior_boundaries: unique in-support roots at posterior 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, strictly ordered
per_donor_criteria.S5: Monte Carlo test against a stateless Poisson null at the donor's own depths and detection fraction with its own decontX shrinkage ratios: at least 80 of 99 replicates fitted and the observed Ashman's D strictly above every fitted null replicate's (p <= 0.01)
per_donor_criteria.D4_diagnostic: Phase-1B M1(b), the high component excludes at least half the detected cells: reported, not gating

derivation.aggregation: every reference donor must qualify (none is dropped) and there must be at least min_reference_donors; primary threshold = median across donors of the posterior-0.5 boundaries; threshold_variants = [median of the 0.25 boundaries, median of the 0.75 boundaries]; rule '>='
derivation.failure: derive() verdict NO_STABLE_SEPARATION -> NO_SUITABLE_REFERENCE; no alternative quantity, fit, criterion or candidate is tried afterwards

rr14_citations.evidence_citation: E-MTAB-10283 (the reference dataset the state separation is measured in), evidence_kind reference_state_separation
rr14_citations.comparability_evidence: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17412607 (the ADOC pipeline code and lock file) together with the committed stack-identification result
rr14_citations.threshold_derivation: NONE VALID: the derivation is this pre-registration's own procedure and has no DOI or accession. Under the owner's citation rule no DOI is minted and no dataset is cited as a method; unless the owner approves an RR14 citation-schema adjustment before the definition-freeze commit, the verdict is at most BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION

verdict_rules: NO_SUITABLE_REFERENCE: no candidate qualifies on metadata; or every qualified candidate fails a value-blind check that is not a comparability failure; or derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION
BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY: no Cell Ranger stack passes the stack-identification test, or the pinned stack cannot process the selected candidate and no later candidate exists

BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION: derive() qualifies but a requirement needs an owner decision not yet taken (the RR14 threshold_derivation citation above, owner acceptance under RR12, or activation of config/personalization.yaml)

QUALIFIED_REFERENCE_FOUND: derive() qualifies and phase2a_contract.evaluate_reference, run on the committed reference files with the manifest named in memory, reports no RR01-RR12 or RR14 failure other than the RR10 activation clause that only the owner's activation commit can satisfy; it enables assumption_conditioned_scenario mapping only, RR13 stays unmet, and no donor-specific model is produced
commit_order: C4: retrieval, provenance, stack identification, reprocessing, qualification table, comparability assessment, derivation result, all after the guard passes
C5 (alone): docs/phase2b/reference/definition_freeze.md naming definition_path/definition_sha256 and nothing else 64-hex (Phase-2A RR10/RR14)
C6: reference manifest, donors and definition files, the RR01-RR12/RR14 audit and the one verdict
activation of config/personalization.yaml only if the owner authorises it
forbidden: reading any candidate KLF12 value before this commit and a passing guard
using the ADOC donors, their values or outcomes to set any rule, threshold, candidate or variant
adhesion, pregnancy, implantation, secretion or model output as an input anywhere
donor .cfg, probabilities, rate modifiers, clamps, mutations or topology changes
deviations: any departure after values are read is recorded as a numbered deviation with its reason in a separate file; nothing here is edited (guard.py refuses a rewritten rules file)
